verdict.rationale: The IRS documents real system-to-system rails: Modernized e-File, an XML-based transmission channel for Authorized IRS e-file Providers, and the IRIS Application-to-Application intake gated by a Transmitter Control Code. The provider enrollment path is published, including an approval clock of up to 45 days and fingerprinting for principals without professional status. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of enrolling and transmitting, and evidence of the technical onboarding material (schemas, test environment, TCC application steps) beyond the overview pages.
